record.paper_title: Research Problems on Relations Between Nijenhuis Geometry and Integrable Systems
record.context_brief: Generic Killing tensors and conservation laws
record.original_question: For a generic Killing tensor K of the constant-curvature metric g, does K admit any nontrivial conservation law?

evidence.quote: Q5 Take a generic Killing K of g. Does it admit any non-trivial conservation law?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a Riemannian (or pseudo-Riemannian) manifold of constant sectional curvature. A symmetric $(2,0)$-tensor field $K^{ij}$ on $M$ is called a Killing tensor of $g$ if it satisfies the Killing equation
$$\nabla^{(i} K^{jk)} = 0,$$
where $\nabla$ is the Levi-Civita connection of $g$ and parentheses denote symmetrization. To every Killing tensor $K$ one associates the quadratic in momenta function $F_K(x,p) = K^{ij}(x) p_i p_j$ on $T^*M$, which is a first integral of the geodesic flow of $g$ (with Hamiltonian $H(x,p) = g^{ij}(x) p_i p_j$).

A conservation law of $K$ is, by definition, a smooth function $F$ on $T^*M$, functionally independent of $H$ and $F_K$, that Poisson-commutes with $F_K$ (equivalently, an additional first integral of the Hamiltonian flow generated by $F_K$ on $T^*M$). The conservation law is called nontrivial if it is not a function of $H$ and $F_K$ alone.

Question: For a generic Killing tensor $K$ of the constant-curvature metric $g$, does $K$ admit any nontrivial conservation law?

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open research problem on relations between Nijenhuis geometry and integrable systems. Web search reveals active work on Nijenhuis integrability for Killing tensors on constant sectional curvature manifolds (algebraic integrability conditions, classifications of separable coordinate systems), but no source resolves the genericity question of whether a generic Killing tensor on a constant-curvature space admits a nontrivial conservation law. Status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Nijenhuis Integrability for Killing Tensors
status_evidence.snippet: Nijenhuis integrability conditions for Killing tensors on constant sectional curvature manifolds translated into algebraic integrability conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on integrability conditions for Killing tensors on constant-curvature spaces, but the generic conservation-law question is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic integrability conditions for Killing tensors on constant sectional curvature manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of new families of integrable Killing tensors via algebraic equations of degree two and three.
status_evidence.claim: Existing constructions are special; the generic case is not addressed.
